push notification.note: 'Push' kept in English per es mobile convention (Android/iOS settings).

share extension.note: Share action itself: 'Compartir con {app}' per existing strings.

bottom sheet.note: No repo signal; 'hoja inferior' (Material Design) is the literal alternative, but 'panel inferior' reads more naturally in user-facing text.

long-press.note: es-419 UIs often use 'mantener presionado'; existing es file leans peninsular ('pulsar').

tap.note: Buttons/instructions: 'toca' (informal imperative); repo also uses 'pulsa' in places.

toast.note: No repo signal; short transient confirmation message.

jailbroken.note: Existing string uses 'dispositivos con jailbrak' (typo for jailbreak). Rooted (Android): 'rooteado'.

app logs.note: Existing mobile strings sometimes keep 'logs' ('Ver logs del servidor'); prefer 'registros' to match the desktop app.

deep link.note: No repo signal; matches Google's es rendering for deep links. 'Enlace profundo' is the literal alternative.

server connection.note: Add a server: 'Agregar un servidor'; switch server: 'Cambiar de servidor'.
